findings.body: Two callers can both read the same stale lock and determine that its owner is gone. Caller A then removes it and creates its own lock; caller B executes this unlink using its earlier observation, deletes A's live lock, and creates another. Both enter the protected work section. Doctor can likewise delete a newly acquired worker lock and stop that worker's Codex process. Stale-lock reclamation must be serialized with acquisition so it cannot delete a replacement owner's lock.
findings.title: Not done: 5. Only one forge work runs per task or fix

findings.body: On Windows, if Forge dies while Codex() is waiting for initialize, CLIENT is still empty: it is populated only after the constructor returns at lines 72–74. The stdin watcher therefore exits the driver without stopping its app-server. A stalled server that does not react to stdin closure remains running. Its identity has not been emitted either, so the record contains only the now-dead driver and app_server=null; the next work or doctor cannot recover it through _stop_leftover (codex.py:307–310). Preserve a way to terminate the child during construction before exiting the Windows driver.
findings.title: Not done: 6. No Codex process is left after work ends

findings.body: The entire cleanup test is skipped on Windows, although the driver implements a separate Windows shutdown path. Consequently the suite cannot detect failures in cleanup during initialization, parent death, or subsequent doctor/work recovery on that platform. Add Windows-compatible lifecycle cases that exercise the real driver and stub server; retain POSIX-only skips only for scenarios that specifically require POSIX signals.

findings.body: The supplied commit-message audit explicitly reports no Functional check paragraph. This user-facing change requires recorded exercises of both covered items: a second work invocation refusing, and cleanup after normal completion, errors, interruption, and crash recovery. Perform those checks and record what was exercised and observed in the required commit-message paragraph.

Separately, tests/test_setup.py:179–183 changes expectations solely for unrelated doctor message rewrites. These test files are outside this part's allowed scope; remove the unrelated setup and wording changes from this branch.
